title: The Bilinear Hilbert Transform Along the Primes
abstract: Lean 4 formalization of the main theorem of The Bilinear Hilbert Transform Along the Primes. The discrete bilinear Hilbert transform along the primes, H_P(f,g)(x) = sum over n != 0 of Lambda(|n|)/n f(x-n) g(x+n), with Lambda the von Mangoldt function, satisfies ||H_P(f,g)||_{l^r} <= C ||f||_{l^p} ||g||_{l^q} for all finitely supported f, g on the integers, whenever p, q > 1, 1/r = 1/p + 1/q, 2/p + 3/q < 3 and 3/p + 2/q < 3 (the Banach range and part of the quasi-Banach range). The proof is assembled from frozen, author-approved intermediate theorems: a restricted-type tri-tile estimate with an epsilon-loss, the smooth truncated bilinear Hilbert transform on the line and on the integers, a vector-valued bilinear form estimate on R x Z/P, the key proposition p:key0, and the U^3 approximation of the von Mangoldt function, which is taken from the author's earlier formalization of A Variation Norm Carleson Theorem Along the Primes (its import closure is included in this repository, see related_formalizations). All results are checked by Lean and depend only on the standard axioms.
